wavy carousel

Motion·by @jmtrivedi·2026-08-22·inspora page·original post

What it is

Wavy carousel (shot on a real iPhone): notifications laid out on a vertical helix - a spiral conveyor of notification cards that wind around an invisible cylinder; dragging rotates the helix so cards swing from bottom-center around the right edge to top, scaling and dimming with depth; flick momentum carries the spin.

Media

Frame-by-frame

0-25%
Finger drags up: the stack of notification cards (Lock Screen style, icon + title + body) rides an S-curve - cards near the finger are flat and large, cards further wind around the bend shrinking and tilting.
25-50%
Cards wrap over the top-right edge: they rotate in 3D (rotateY + perspective), foreshortening as they go around the cylinder's back, reappearing dimmed at the left.
50-75%
Fast flick: helix spins with momentum - cards blur slightly with velocity; spacing bunches then stretches like a spring along the curve.
75-100%
Spin decays and the stack settles into a neat vertical list at rest (cards aligned, full opacity).

Build prompt

Build a helical notification carousel. Cards: 15 iOS-style notifications (64px, 14px radius, icon + bold title + 1-line body) parameterized by angle a_i on a vertical helix: x = cx + R*sin(a), y = cy - pitch*a, scale = 0.6 + 0.4*cos(a-relative-facing), rotateY = -sin(a)*55deg, opacity = 0.35 + 0.65*max(0,cos(a)). Drag deltaY adds angular velocity; per frame: a += v, v *= 0.95 (momentum decay); cards sort by depth (painter's order) and take transforms from the helix equations (perspective 900px on the container). On release near the 'flat' zone, spring the facing card's angle to 0 so the stack settles into a straight list (stiffness 120, damping 14). At high |v| apply a subtle motion blur (filter blur min(|v|*0.5, 4)px). Cards bunch with a spring along the helix: spacing angle relaxes toward 14deg with lag proportional to index.

Mechanics

trigger
vertical drag / flick
elements
notification cards (~15), helix path (cylinder projection)
properties
card position on helix (angle), rotateY foreshortening, scale + opacity by depth, momentum + spring settle
timing
frame-linked to drag; flick decay ~1.2s
easing
exponential momentum decay; spring on release-to-list
loop
no
